item.title: The Stickers on Fruit Are Actually Non-Toxic?!
item.description: Those little stickers on apples and bananas are generally made with food-contact-safe materials! Accidentally swallowing one is unlikely to harm you, but they're not meant to be eaten, so it's best to remove them.

item.title: Can You Clean Baking Sheets With Your Oven's Self-Clean Mode?!
item.description: Some people use their oven's self-cleaning cycle to remove baked-on grime from baking sheets. But the extreme heat can warp or damage them, so it's best to stick to manufacturer-approved cleaning methods!
